question_en: Switch to the guide beam used for checking the sample position.
setup: Required: arm the measurement beam with set_laser_power(5) (power_armed=True). Before arming, _beam_state is already 'guide', so any answer passes. Judged by get_laser_status().power_armed == False.
todo_from_sheet: The default of restore_guide_beam in acquire_spectrum is True, so after a measurement item the beam may already be the guide beam. Reset to the measurement beam at the start of the item.
